title: SEO Score
description: Output contract of the seo-ranking skill's scoring module (module 20, SCORING.md): the SEO Content Score (0-100, always computable, deduction-based across 9 weighted categories) — the article-generation gate; the Technical SEO Score (SITE-LEVEL: in the article-generation pipeline it is always NOT_MEASURABLE with a null value and empty categories, because technical data is never fetched as a side effect of generating an article — it is only MEASURABLE in an explicit maintenance context with real data, owned by the CMS's SEO dashboard); and the Overall SEO Health blend (0-100, A-F grade, explicit basis and formula — 'content-only' basis in the article pipeline). Every deduction references an issue type from the VALIDATION.md registry so lost points trace to real issues; earned values carry two decimals; value fields carry the rounded final integer. Scores rank improvement priorities — they never promise rankings and never override the verdict.

issue_type.description: snake_case issue type from the canonical registry in VALIDATION.md (e.g. thin_coverage, keyword_stuffing, cwv_issue); extend only via SEO-V41+.

count.description: How many issues of this type were deducted in the category.

amount.description: Total points deducted (two decimals; capped at the category weight; special-case integrity deductions may zero the category).

name.description: Category name exactly as defined in SCORING.md.

weight.description: Category weight; weights are tunable configuration and must sum to 100 per score.

earned.description: Points kept after deductions (two decimals; 0 <= earned <= weight; integrity overrides can set earned to 0).

deductions.description: Every lost point traces to an issue object in the validation report; earned values with no corresponding report issues are audit errors.

seo_content_score.description: Score 1 of 3: how strong the page is as search content. Always computable; technical-section issues do not touch it.

value.description: Rounded final integer (compute with two decimals, round half up, per SCORING.md).

categories.description: The 9 default categories and weights per SCORING.md: Search Intent Alignment 12, Content Quality & E-E-A-T 14, Topic Coverage 12, Information Gain 12, On-Page SEO 22, Internal Linking 8, Image SEO 6, Structured Data 8, AI Search Readiness 6.

technical_seo_score.description: Score 2 of 3: SITE-LEVEL technical soundness — never computed during article generation (NOT_MEASURABLE there); measurable only in explicit maintenance contexts with real crawl/platform data. Status first, number second — technical health is never inferred from correct title/meta/H1.

status.description: NOT_MEASURABLE without real crawl/platform data — the honest default and the ONLY state in the article-generation pipeline, not a zero and not a pass.

value.description: The score when MEASURABLE, otherwise null.

categories.description: Empty when NOT_MEASURABLE; when MEASURABLE the 8 default categories per SCORING.md (Crawlability & robots.txt 15, Sitemap & Indexation 20, Canonical & Redirects 15, Duplicate Content 12, Structured Data validity 10, Broken Links 8, Mobile Readiness 10, Core Web Vitals 10 — rescaled to 100 when CWV lacks real data).

overall_seo_health.description: Score 3 of 3: the blend, with its basis stated. Never overrides the verdict — a 92 with a fabricated statistic is still a FAIL.

value.description: 0.7 x content + 0.3 x technical when both are measurable, otherwise the content score. In the article-generation pipeline this is always the content score on a 'content-only' basis.

basis.description: Exactly what the overall number rests on: 'content-only' or the content+technical blend.

formula.description: The arithmetic applied, e.g. 'overall = content (technical NOT_MEASURABLE)' or 'overall = 0.7 x content + 0.3 x technical'.
